Our fintech team has built the `currencykit-sdk` Java library (located in the `currencykit-sdk/` folder in the workspace) and we need to get it published to the Maven Central public artifact repository for other developers to use. The project compiles fine locally, but it's nowhere near ready for public distribution — the build configuration is incomplete, key metadata is missing, signing is not set up, and the publishing toolchain hasn't been configured at all.

Please bring everything into compliance so the project is fully ready to deploy to Maven Central. This includes setting up the project's build descriptor (`pom.xml`) with all required metadata and plugins, configuring the local Maven credentials file (`~/.m2/settings.xml`) with a `central` server entry and a `release` profile containing GPG signing properties, and ensuring the GPG agent is configured for headless/automated operation (no UI pop-ups during signing).

The target repository uses the modern Central Portal workflow (not the legacy OSSRH). Use placeholder values for any credentials you cannot know (e.g., token usernames/passwords, passphrases). The library's group ID is `io.github.fintechoss` and it should link to `https://github.com/fintechoss/currencykit-sdk` as its project URL.
